jobs.details: Procurement Officer UNODC - United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime Cairo International P-3, International Professional - Internationally recruited position level Speaks Arabic, English, French Application deadline: December 01, 2026 (13 days) Apply Summary by Impactpool The Procurement Officer position at the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) in Cairo involves overseeing procurement functions for the Middle East and North Africa region. The incumbent will manage complex procurement processes, including construction projects, and ensure compliance with UN policies. Responsibilities include developing procurement strategies, conducting negotiations, and providing training to staff. The role requires collaboration with various stakeholders and adherence to financial regulations. Candidate Requirements: Advanced university degree in business administration, commerce, engineering, law or related field Professional certification in supply chains (CIPS Level 4 or equivalent) Minimum five years of professional work experience in procurement Experience with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems Experience with construction projects and procurement of architectural services Experience managing a team within the UN system or international organization Proficiency in English; French or Arabic desirable Org. Setting and Reporting This position is located in the Regional Office for the Middle East and North Africa (ROMENA) of the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) in Cairo, Egypt. Check cleaning, disinfecting and clearance of machines, utensils and rooms according to SOPs approved by the Quality Assurance Department. HSE Responsibilities: Ensure that the HSE policy is communicated to all employees under his control. jobs.details: Viatris Egypt S.A.E Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases. We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making. Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the Quality Control Analyst (Microbiology) role will make an impact: Position summary: Responsible for the QC microbiology laboratory functions and the corresponding documentation to support the timely disposition of product. Job Specific technical/Functional/Professional Competencies: Perform routine and non-routine microbiological testing of finished products, raw materials, utilities, and water systems in accordance with approved procedures. Perform environmental monitoring (viable and non-viable, where applicable) of classified manufacturing and laboratory areas and report any potential contamination sources to the Microbiology Supervisor. Perform growth promotion testing of culture media and maintain all associated records. Perform microbiological method suitability studies and verification activities as required. Perform disinfectant efficacy studies and support periodic requalification of disinfectants used within manufacturing and laboratory areas.
